# I. Overview

## 1\. User Requirements

### 1.1 Actors

| **#** | **Actor**               | **Description**                                                                                             |
| ----- | ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1     | Admin                   | Manages user accounts, roles, room/service master data, and revenue reports.                                |
| 2     | Receptionist            | Confirms reservations, performs AI-assisted check-in, handles check-out and billing.                        |
| 3     | Customer                | Searches available rooms, books rooms online, orders services, and views invoices.                          |
| 4     | Kitchen / Laundry Staff | Receives and processes service orders in the real-time workflow.                                            |
| 5     | Housekeeping            | Updates room cleaning status and reports maintenance issues.                                                |
| 6     | System                  | Validates availability, calculates bills, changes room states, records audit logs, and sends notifications. |

### 1.2 Use Cases

**a. Diagram(s)**

The following diagram is the overall use case diagram of HSRM. It arranges all system use cases from UC01 to UC11 and shows how each actor interacts with the hotel operation system.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

_Figure 1. Overall Use Case Diagram of HSRM_

**b. Descriptions**

| **ID** | **Feature**         | **Use Case**           | **Use Case Description**                                                                             |
| ------ | ------------------- | ---------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| UC01   | Common Functions    | Login System           | Allows all roles to authenticate and access their role-based dashboard.                              |
| UC02   | Account Management  | Manage Profile         | Allows authenticated users to view and update basic profile information.                             |
| UC03   | Reservation         | Search Available Rooms | Allows customers or receptionists to search rooms by dates, room type, and availability.             |
| UC04   | Reservation         | Book Room              | Creates a reservation after a room is selected and blocks the room from conflicting bookings.        |
| UC05   | Reception           | Check-in with AI OCR   | Receptionist scans ID card/passport; AI OCR extracts guest information and system confirms check-in. |
| UC06   | Service Ordering    | Order Service          | Customer selects a hotel service, quantity, and submits a request during the stay.                   |
| UC07   | Service Fulfillment | Process Service Order  | Kitchen/laundry staff receive service orders and update their processing status.                     |
| UC08   | Housekeeping        | Update Room Status     | Housekeeping updates room status such as Dirty, Available, In-use, or Maintenance.                   |
| UC09   | Billing             | View Temporary Invoice | Customer or receptionist views room charges and completed service charges before checkout.           |
| UC10   | Billing             | Payment & Check-out    | Receptionist confirms payment, creates payment record, completes booking, and sets room to Dirty.    |
| UC11   | Reporting           | View Revenue Report    | Admin views revenue, occupancy, and service statistics for management decisions.                     |

## 2\. Overall Functionalities

### 2.1 Screens Flow

The system flow starts from the Login screen. After authentication, the user is redirected to a role-based dashboard. Receptionist users can manage booking, check-in, invoice, and checkout. Customers can search rooms, book rooms, order services, and view invoices. Kitchen/Laundry staff process service orders. Housekeeping updates room status. Admin users manage master data and view reports.

### 2.2 Screen Descriptions

| **#** | **Feature**  | **Screen**              | **Description**                                                                                         |
| ----- | ------------ | ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1     | Common       | Login                   | Inputs username/password, validates role, and redirects to the correct dashboard.                       |
| 2     | Common       | Role-based Dashboard    | Displays functions based on user role: receptionist, customer, kitchen/laundry, housekeeping, or admin. |
| 3     | Reservation  | Search Room / Book Room | Filters available rooms by check-in/check-out dates and room type, then creates a booking request.      |
| 4     | Reception    | Check-in OCR            | Scans ID document, auto-fills guest data, confirms room assignment, and updates status to IN_USE.       |
| 5     | Service      | Service Order           | Customer chooses service item and quantity, then submits order.                                         |
| 6     | Service      | Kitchen/Laundry Queue   | Service staff receive real-time orders and update status.                                               |
| 7     | Billing      | Invoice / Checkout      | Shows room fee, completed service fee, total amount, payment method, and checkout confirmation.         |
| 8     | Housekeeping | Room Status Update      | Displays dirty/maintenance rooms and allows room status updates.                                        |
| 9     | Admin        | Report Screen           | Displays revenue, occupancy rate, and service revenue statistics.                                       |

### 2.3 Screen Authorization

| **Screen**            | **Admin** | **Receptionist** | **Kitchen/Laundry** | **Housekeeping** | **Customer** |
| --------------------- | --------- | ---------------- | ------------------- | ---------------- | ------------ |
| Login                 | View      | View             | View                | View             | View         |
| Dashboard by Role     | View      | View             | View                | View             | View         |

| Search Rooms          | R         | R                | \-                  | \-               | R            |
| Book Room             | \-        | C/R/U            | \-                  | \-               | C/R          |
| Check-in / Check-out  | \-        | C/R/U            | \-                  | \-               | \-           |
| Order Service         | \-        | \-               | \-                  | \-               | C/R          |
| Process Service Order | \-        | \-               | R/U                 | \-               | \-           |
| Update Room Status    | C/R/U/D   | \-               | \-                  | R/U              | \-           |

_Note: C = Create, R = Read, U = Update, D = Delete, - = No access._

### 2.4 Non-UI Functions

| **#** | **Feature** | **System Function**    | **Description**                                                                                                 |
| ----- | ----------- | ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1     | Security    | Password Hashing       | Hash user passwords using BCrypt before storing them in the database.                                           |
| 2     | Security    | JWT Authentication     | Generate and verify JSON Web Tokens for protected API requests.                                                 |
| 3     | Reservation | Availability Checking  | Detect date overlaps to prevent double-booking of the same room.                                                |
| 4     | Reception   | AI OCR Extraction      | Extract guest information from CCCD/passport images for check-in.                                               |
| 5     | Service     | Real-time Notification | Notify kitchen/laundry dashboards when new service orders are created and notify customers when status changes. |
| 6     | Billing     | Automated Billing      | Calculate room charge based on actual nights and add all completed service orders.                              |
| 7     | Operation   | Room State Automation  | Change room states across BOOKED, IN_USE, DIRTY, AVAILABLE, and MAINTENANCE based on business events.           |
| 8     | Audit       | Audit Log              | Record critical actions such as check-in, check-out, service cancellation, and payment creation.                |

## 3\. System High Level Design

### 3.1 Database Design

**a. Database Schema**

The HSRM database includes users, guests, room_types, rooms, bookings, services, service_orders, payments, staffs, and audit_logs. Rooms reference room_types; bookings reference guests and rooms; payments reference bookings; service_orders reference bookings and services.

**b. Table Descriptions**

| **No** | **Table**      | **Description**                                                                                                 |
| ------ | -------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 01     | users          | Stores user accounts and authentication information. Primary key: user_id.                                      |
| 02     | guests         | Stores guest/customer information. Primary key: guest_id.                                                       |
| 03     | room_types     | Stores room category, capacity, and nightly price. Primary key: room_type_id.                                   |
| 04     | rooms          | Stores hotel room number, type, floor, and operational status. Primary key: room_id; foreign key: room_type_id. |
| 05     | bookings       | Stores reservations and stay lifecycle. Primary key: booking_id; foreign keys: guest_id, room_id.               |
| 06     | services       | Stores hotel service catalog and service price. Primary key: service_id.                                        |
| 07     | service_orders | Stores service usage records for a booking. Primary key: order_id; foreign keys: booking_id, service_id.        |
| 08     | payments       | Stores payment and billing information. Primary key: payment_id; foreign key: booking_id.                       |
| 09     | staffs         | Stores staff information, position, and salary. Primary key: staff_id.                                          |
| 10     | audit_logs     | Stores operational audit history. Primary key: log_id; reference_id links to affected business record.          |

### 3.2 Code Packages

The following package/class diagram shows the expected package structure and main classes of the HSRM source code. This design helps the development team separate authentication, booking, room, service, billing, reporting, and utility responsibilities.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

_Figure 2. Expected Package and Class Diagram_

**Package descriptions and expected classes**

| **No** | **Package**       | **Expected Main Classes**                                                        | **Description**                                                                              |
| ------ | ----------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 01     | authentication    | AuthController, AuthService, JwtUtil, PasswordUtil, AuthMiddleware               | Handles login, logout, JWT authentication, password hashing, and role-based access control.  |
| 02     | usermanagement    | User, UserDTO, UserController, UserService, UserRepository                       | Manages user accounts, roles, profile information, and account status.                       |
| 03     | guestmanagement   | Guest, GuestDTO, GuestController, GuestService, GuestRepository                  | Manages guest profiles and duplicate checking by citizen ID/passport number.                 |
| 04     | roommanagement    | Room, RoomType, RoomController, RoomService, RoomRepository                      | Manages room details, room types, prices, floors, room status, and availability.             |
| 05     | bookingmanagement | Booking, BookingDTO, BookingController, BookingService, BookingRepository        | Handles room searching, booking creation, check-in status updates, and booking cancellation. |
| 06     | ocrmanagement     | OCRController, OCRService, OCRResultDTO                                          | Processes ID card/passport images and returns extracted guest information.                   |
| 07     | servicemanagement | Service, ServiceOrder, ServiceController, ServiceOrderController, ServiceService | Manages service catalog, service orders, and order status workflow.                          |
| 08     | notification      | SocketServer, NotificationService, EventHandler                                  | Sends real-time notifications between customers and service staff.                           |
| 09     | paymentmanagement | Payment, InvoiceDTO, PaymentController, PaymentService, PaymentRepository        | Calculates total billing, creates payment records, and supports check-out.                   |
| 10     | auditmanagement   | AuditLog, AuditLogService, AuditLogRepository                                    | Records important system actions for transparency and fraud prevention.                      |
| 11     | staffmanagement   | Staff, StaffController, StaffService, StaffRepository                            | Manages staff information, positions, and employee data.                                     |
| 12     | reportmanagement  | ReportController, ReportService, RevenueReportDTO                                | Generates revenue, occupancy, and service usage reports.                                     |
| 13     | database          | DatabaseConfig, ConnectionPool, MigrationScript                                  | Provides database configuration, connection, and migration support.                          |
| 14     | utils             | DateUtil, ValidationUtil, PriceUtil, ResponseUtil                                | Provides reusable helper functions for validation, dates, prices, and responses.             |

# II. Requirement Specifications

The use cases are rearranged in logical order from common functions to reservation, reception, service, room operation, billing, and reporting. Each use case follows the same Functional Description Template used in the original RDS form.

## 1\. Common Functions

### 1.1 UC01_Login System

**a. Functional Description**

| **Field**          | **Description**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| UC ID and Name:    | UC01 - Login System                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Created By:        | Business Analyst Date Created: 27/05/2026                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Primary Actor:     | Admin, Receptionist, Customer, Kitchen/Laundry Staff, Housekeeping Secondary Actors: System                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Trigger:           | User opens the application or accesses an authenticated feature.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Description:       | User provides username and password. The system authenticates the account, checks role and status, generates a JWT token, and redirects the user to the role-based dashboard.                                                                                                                                              |
| Preconditions:     | PRE-1: User account exists. <br>PRE-2: User account is active. <br>PRE-3: User has been assigned a valid role.                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Postconditions:    | POST-1: User login session is created. <br>POST-2: JWT token is generated for protected requests. <br>POST-3: User reaches the correct role-based dashboard.                                                                                                                                                               |
| Normal Flow:       | 1.0 Login System <br>1\. User opens Login screen. <br>2\. User enters username and password. <br>3\. User clicks Login. <br>4\. System validates input fields. <br>5\. System verifies password hash, account status, and role. <br>6\. System generates JWT token. <br>7\. System redirects user to role-based dashboard. |
| Alternative Flows: | UC01.A1: Existing valid session - system verifies token and redirects directly to dashboard. <br>UC01.A2: Logout - system removes local token and returns user to Login screen.                                                                                                                                            |
| Exceptions:        | UC01.E1: Invalid credentials - system shows error and does not create session. <br>UC01.E2: Inactive account - system denies login and asks user to contact admin. <br>UC01.E3: Server error - system shows retry message.                                                                                                 |
| Priority:          | Must Have                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Frequency of Use:  | High; used whenever users access protected functions.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Business Rules:    | BR07                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Other Information: | Password must never be stored or displayed in plain text.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Assumptions:       | Users have been created and assigned valid roles before login.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

**b. Business Rules**

| **ID** | **Business Rule** | **Business Rule Description**                             |
| ------ | ----------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| BR07   | Password Security | Password must be hashed using BCrypt before being stored. |

## 2\. Reservation & Reception Feature

### 2.1 UC03_Search Available Rooms

**a. Functional Description**

| **Field**          | **Description**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| UC ID and Name:    | UC03 - Search Available Rooms                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Created By:        | Business Analyst Date Created: 27/05/2026                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Primary Actor:     | Customer, Receptionist Secondary Actors: System                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Trigger:           | User selects check-in/check-out date, room type, and clicks Search.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Description:       | System searches available rooms by date range and room type while preventing double booking.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Preconditions:     | PRE-1: User has access to booking screen. <br>PRE-2: Check-in and check-out dates are valid. <br>PRE-3: Room type exists in the system.                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Postconditions:    | POST-1: Available rooms are displayed. <br>POST-2: No booking record is created during search.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Normal Flow:       | 3.0 Search Available Rooms <br>1\. User opens booking/search screen. <br>2\. User selects check-in date and check-out date. <br>3\. User selects room type or all room types. <br>4\. User clicks Search. <br>5\. System validates date range. <br>6\. System checks room status and existing bookings. <br>7\. System displays available rooms. |
| Alternative Flows: | UC03.A1: Search all room types - system returns rooms from all active room types.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Exceptions:        | UC03.E1: Invalid date range - system requires valid dates. <br>UC03.E2: No available rooms - system displays no availability message.                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Priority:          | Must Have                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Frequency of Use:  | High                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Business Rules:    | BR01                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Other Information: | Search results must exclude occupied, dirty, and maintenance rooms.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Assumptions:       | Room and booking data are synchronized.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

**b. Business Rules**

| **ID** | **Business Rule** | **Business Rule Description**                                            |
| ------ | ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| BR01   | Availability Rule | A room can be booked only if it does not overlap another active booking. |

### 2.2 UC04_Book Room

**a. Functional Description**

| **Field**          | **Description**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| UC ID and Name:    | UC04 - Book Room                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Created By:        | Business Analyst Date Created: 27/05/2026                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Primary Actor:     | Customer, Receptionist Secondary Actors: System                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Trigger:           | User selects an available room and clicks Book Now.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Description:       | System creates a reservation, calculates estimated price, and blocks the room for the selected period.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Preconditions:     | PRE-1: User has searched available rooms. <br>PRE-2: At least one room is available for requested dates. <br>PRE-3: Guest information is valid.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Postconditions:    | POST-1: Booking record is created with Pending/Booked status. <br>POST-2: Selected room is reserved for the booking period. <br>POST-3: Confirmation information is shown.                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Normal Flow:       | 4.0 Book Room <br>1\. User selects an available room. <br>2\. User enters or confirms guest information. <br>3\. User clicks Book Now. <br>4\. System validates guest and booking data. <br>5\. System checks availability again. <br>6\. System calculates estimated total price. <br>7\. System creates booking record. <br>8\. System displays booking confirmation. |
| Alternative Flows: | UC04.A1: Receptionist creates booking for walk-in or phone customer. <br>UC04.A2: Existing guest profile is reused when citizen ID/phone matches.                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Exceptions:        | UC04.E1: Room no longer available - user must select another room. <br>UC04.E2: Invalid guest information - system asks user to correct data. <br>UC04.E3: Database conflict - transaction is rolled back.                                                                                                                                                              |
| Priority:          | Must Have                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Frequency of Use:  | High                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Business Rules:    | BR01, BR02, BR09                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Other Information: | Availability must be checked again before inserting the booking record.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Assumptions:       | Room price is taken from room_types table.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

**b. Business Rules**

| **ID** | **Business Rule**      | **Business Rule Description**                                            |
| ------ | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| BR01   | Availability Rule      | A room can be booked only if it does not overlap another active booking. |
| BR02   | Room Price Calculation | Room fee is price_per_night multiplied by stayed nights.                 |
| BR09   | Pending Expiration     | Pending reservation is valid for 24 hours if not confirmed.              |

### 2.3 UC05_Check-in with AI OCR

**a. Functional Description**

| **Field**          | **Description**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| UC ID and Name:    | UC05 - Check-in with AI OCR                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

| Primary Actor:     | Receptionist Secondary Actors: System, AI OCR Service                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Trigger:           | Receptionist selects a booking and starts check-in.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Description:       | Receptionist verifies booking, scans CCCD/passport, OCR extracts guest information, and system confirms check-in.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Preconditions:     | PRE-1: Receptionist is logged in. <br>PRE-2: Booking exists and is not cancelled. <br>PRE-3: OCR service is available or manual entry is allowed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Postconditions:    | POST-1: Guest profile is created or updated. <br>POST-2: Booking status becomes Checked-In. <br>POST-3: Room status becomes IN_USE. <br>POST-4: Check-in action is recorded in audit_logs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Normal Flow:       | 5.0 Check-in with AI OCR <br>1\. Receptionist opens Check-in screen. <br>2\. System loads booking details. <br>3\. Receptionist uploads/scans ID document. <br>4\. System sends image to OCR service. <br>5\. OCR returns guest information. <br>6\. System auto-fills check-in form. <br>7\. Receptionist verifies and confirms data. <br>8\. System saves guest data and updates booking/room status. <br>9\. System records audit log. |
| Alternative Flows: | UC05.A1: OCR confidence is low - receptionist manually corrects extracted fields. <br>UC05.A2: Returning guest found - system reuses guest profile.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Exceptions:        | UC05.E1: OCR service unavailable - system allows manual input. <br>UC05.E2: Booking not found - system shows error. <br>UC05.E3: Room unavailable - receptionist assigns another room.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Priority:          | Should Have / High                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Frequency of Use:  | High during reception working hours.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Business Rules:    | BR06, BR10                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Other Information: | OCR reduces manual data entry and human errors.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Assumptions:       | OCR provider supports Vietnamese CCCD and international passport images.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

**b. Business Rules**

| **ID** | **Business Rule**      | **Business Rule Description**                                        |
| ------ | ---------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| BR06   | Receptionist Authority | Only receptionist can perform check-in/check-out.                    |
| BR10   | Audit Critical Actions | Important check-in/check-out changes must be recorded in audit_logs. |

## 3\. Service Feature

### 3.1 UC06_Order Service

**a. Functional Description**

| **Field**          | **Description**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| UC ID and Name:    | UC06 - Order Service                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Created By:        | Business Analyst Date Created: 27/05/2026                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Primary Actor:     | Customer Secondary Actors: System, Kitchen/Laundry Staff                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Trigger:           | Customer selects a service item and clicks Order.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Description:       | Customer orders food, beverage, laundry, or other hotel services during an active stay.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Preconditions:     | PRE-1: Customer has an active Checked-In booking. <br>PRE-2: Selected service exists and is active.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Postconditions:    | POST-1: Service order is created with ORDERED status. <br>POST-2: Service staff dashboard receives a real-time notification.                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Normal Flow:       | 6.0 Order Service <br>1\. Customer opens Service Order screen. <br>2\. System displays service catalog. <br>3\. Customer selects service item and quantity. <br>4\. System calculates estimated price. <br>5\. Customer submits order. <br>6\. System creates service_orders record. <br>7\. System sends real-time notification to relevant staff. |
| Alternative Flows: | UC06.A1: Customer cancels before staff starts processing - order status becomes CANCELLED.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Exceptions:        | UC06.E1: Service unavailable - system blocks order. <br>UC06.E2: No active booking - system denies ordering. <br>UC06.E3: Notification failure - order remains saved and staff can refresh queue.                                                                                                                                                   |
| Priority:          | Must Have                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Frequency of Use:  | Medium to High depending on guest demand.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Business Rules:    | BR03                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Other Information: | Service ordering uses Socket.io for real-time updates.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Assumptions:       | Customer is checked in before ordering services.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

**b. Business Rules**

| **ID** | **Business Rule**    | **Business Rule Description**                                              |
| ------ | -------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| BR03   | Service Status Order | Service order status follows ORDERED -> PROCESSING -> COMPLETED/CANCELLED. |

# III. Design Specifications

## 1\. SubFeature: Booking Screen

This screen supports UC03 and UC04. It allows customers or receptionists to search available rooms and create a booking.

**UI Design**

Mockup (textual wireframe):

\--------------------------------------------------  
| Booking Screen |  
| Check-in: \[\_\_/\_\_/\_**\_\] Check-out: \[\_\_/\_\_/\_**\_\] |

| Room Type: \[Single v\] \[Search\] |
| ---------------------------------- | ------ | ------- | ----------- | --- |
| Room 101                           | Single | Floor 1 | 500,000 VND | ( ) |
| Room 102                           | Double | Floor 1 | 800,000 VND | ( ) |
| \[BOOK NOW\]                       |

\--------------------------------------------------

| **Field Name** | **Field Type**       | **Description / Validation**                                      |
| -------------- | -------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| check_in_date  | DatePicker           | Required; must be today or future date.                           |
| check_out_date | DatePicker           | Required; must be greater than check_in_date by at least 1 night. |
| room_type      | Dropdown             | Loaded from room_types table.                                     |
| btnSearch      | Button               | Calls GET /api/rooms/available.                                   |
| roomList       | Table / Radio Button | Displays available room number, type, floor, and price.           |
| btnBook        | Button               | Creates booking by calling POST /api/bookings.                    |

**Database Access**

| **Table**    | **CRUD** | **Description**                                                              |
| ------------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| room_types   | R        | Load room type list and price.                                               |
| rooms        | R/U      | Read available rooms; update room status to BOOKED after successful booking. |
| bookings     | C/R      | Create booking and validate date overlaps.                                   |
| guests/users | R        | Identify current customer or walk-in guest.                                  |

**SQL Commands**

Find available rooms  
SELECT r.\*  
FROM rooms r  
WHERE r.room_type_id = ?  
AND r.status = 'AVAILABLE'  
AND r.room_id NOT IN (  
SELECT b.room_id  
FROM bookings b  
WHERE b.booking_status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Checked-Out')  
AND (b.check_in_date &lt; ? AND b.check_out_date &gt; ?)  
);  
Create booking  
INSERT INTO bookings (guest_id, room_id, check_in_date, check_out_date, total_price, booking_status)  
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'Pending');  
Update room status  
UPDATE rooms SET status = 'BOOKED' WHERE room_id = ?;

## 2\. SubFeature: Check-in with AI OCR Screen

This screen supports UC05. Receptionist verifies a booking, scans guest identity document, and confirms check-in.

**UI Design**

Mockup (textual wireframe):

\--------------------------------------------------  
| Check-in OCR - Booking ID: \[\_\_\_\_\] \[Search\] |  
| Upload CCCD/Passport: \[Choose File\] \[Scan OCR\] |  
| Full Name: \[Auto filled / editable\] |  
| ID No.: \[Auto filled / editable\] |  
| DOB: \[Auto filled / editable\] |  
| Actual Room: \[Room 101 v\] |  
| \[CONFIRM CHECK-IN\] |  
\--------------------------------------------------

| **Field Name** | **Field Type**       | **Description / Validation**                              |
| -------------- | -------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| booking_id     | Text Box / Search    | Required; used to load pending booking.                   |
| id_document    | File Upload / Webcam | Accepts CCCD/passport image.                              |
| ocrResult      | Auto-filled Form     | Full name, citizen/passport ID, DOB, gender, nationality. |
| room_id        | Dropdown             | Actual room assignment; default from booking.             |
| btnConfirm     | Button               | Saves guest data and confirms check-in.                   |

**Database Access**

| **Table**  | **CRUD** | **Description**                                             |
| ---------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| bookings   | R/U      | Read booking and update booking_status to Checked-In.       |
| guests     | R/C/U    | Find existing guest by citizen_id or create/update profile. |
| rooms      | R/U      | Validate room and set status to IN_USE.                     |
| audit_logs | C        | Record check-in action.                                     |

**SQL Commands**

Search guest by citizen ID  
SELECT \* FROM guests WHERE citizen_id = ?;  
Insert guest if not exists  
INSERT INTO guests(full_name, phone, email, address, citizen_id)  
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?);  
Confirm check-in  
UPDATE bookings SET booking_status = 'Checked-In' WHERE booking_id = ?;  
UPDATE rooms SET status = 'IN_USE' WHERE room_id = ?;  
Write audit log  
INSERT INTO audit_logs(reference_id, action, changed_by, old_value, new_value, created_at)  
VALUES (?, 'CHECK_IN', ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);

## 3\. SubFeature: Service Order Screen

This screen supports UC06 and UC07. Customers create service orders; service staff process them in real time.

**UI Design**

Mockup (textual wireframe):

\--------------------------------------------------  
| Service Order |  
| Food & Beverage: \[Fried Rice\] Price: 50,000 VND |  
| Quantity: \[-\] 2 \[+\] |

| Total: 100,000 VND \[ORDER NOW\]              |
| --------------------------------------------- |
| My Orders: Ordered -> Processing -> Completed |

\--------------------------------------------------

| **Field Name**  | **Field Type**       | **Description / Validation**                  |
| --------------- | -------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| service_id      | Dropdown / Card List | Loaded from services table.                   |
| quantity        | Number Input         | Required; minimum 1.                          |
| estimated_total | Label                | Calculated as quantity x service price.       |
| btnOrder        | Button               | Creates order with ORDERED status.            |
| order_status    | Status Badge         | ORDERED, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, or CANCELLED. |

**Database Access**

| **Table**      | **CRUD** | **Description**                               |
| -------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| services       | R        | Load active service catalog.                  |
| service_orders | C/R/U    | Create service order and update order status. |
| bookings       | R        | Validate active booking.                      |

**SQL Commands**

Load services  
SELECT \* FROM services;  
Create service order  
INSERT INTO service_orders (booking_id, service_id, quantity, total_price, order_status)  
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'Ordered');  
Update service order status  
UPDATE service_orders SET order_status = ? WHERE order_id = ?;

## 4\. SubFeature: Checkout & Billing Screen

This screen supports UC09 and UC10. It calculates total bill and records payment/check-out.

**UI Design**

Mockup (textual wireframe):

\--------------------------------------------------  
| Checkout - Booking RES123 |  
| Room: 3 nights x 500,000 VND = 1,500,000 VND |  
| Services: |  
| - Fried Rice (2) 100,000 VND |  
| - Laundry Shirt (3) 150,000 VND |  
| TOTAL: 1,750,000 VND |  
| Payment: \[Cash v\] \[CONFIRM PAYMENT\] |  
\--------------------------------------------------

| **Field Name** | **Field Type**    | **Description / Validation**                     |
| -------------- | ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| booking_id     | Text Box / Search | Required; identifies active stay.                |
| room_charge    | Read-only Label   | Actual nights x room price.                      |
| service_charge | Read-only Table   | Only completed service orders are included.      |
| payment_method | Dropdown          | Cash, bank transfer, or internal payment method. |
| btnPay         | Button            | Creates payment and completes checkout.          |

**Database Access**

| **Table**               | **CRUD** | **Description**                                         |
| ----------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| bookings                | R/U      | Read booking and update status to Checked-Out.          |
| rooms                   | U        | Set room status to DIRTY after checkout.                |
| service_orders/services | R        | Read completed service charges.                         |
| payments                | C/R      | Create payment record and retrieve invoice information. |
| audit_logs              | C        | Record billing/payment action.                          |

**SQL Commands**

Get completed service orders  
SELECT so.order_id, s.service_name, so.quantity, so.total_price  
FROM service_orders so  
JOIN services s ON so.service_id = s.service_id  
WHERE so.booking_id = ? AND so.order_status = 'Completed';  
Create payment  
INSERT INTO payments (booking_id, amount, payment_method, payment_date, payment_status)  
VALUES (?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'Paid');  
Complete checkout  
UPDATE bookings SET booking_status = 'Checked-Out' WHERE booking_id = ?;  
UPDATE rooms SET status = 'DIRTY' WHERE room_id = ?;  
Audit payment  
INSERT INTO audit_logs(reference_id, action, changed_by, old_value, new_value, created_at)  
VALUES (?, 'CREATE_PAYMENT', ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP);

# IV. Appendix

## 1\. Assumptions & Dependencies

| **ID** | **Type**   | **Description**                                                                                                    |
| ------ | ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| AS-01  | Assumption | Users have internet-enabled devices and modern browsers supporting JavaScript.                                     |
| AS-02  | Assumption | Hotel staff are trained to use role-based dashboards and update statuses correctly.                                |
| AS-03  | Assumption | Receptionist can manually correct OCR results when extracted data is incomplete.                                   |
| DE-01  | Dependency | Database server must be available for booking, billing, and audit transactions.                                    |
| DE-02  | Dependency | Docker runtime is available for containerized deployment.                                                          |
| DE-03  | Dependency | Socket.io service is running for real-time internal notifications.                                                 |
| DE-04  | Dependency | External OCR provider such as Google Cloud Vision, AWS Textract, or domestic OCR API is available for AI check-in. |

## 2\. Limitations & Exclusions

- No international online payment gateway integration such as PayPal or Stripe in the first version.
- No detailed ingredient/material inventory management.
- No physical smart-lock or key-card hardware integration.
- No multi-language support in the initial release.
- No in-house AI model training; OCR is implemented through existing cloud/specialized APIs.

## 3\. Business Rules

| **ID** | **Category**  | **Rule Definition**                                                                                                               |
| ------ | ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| BR01   | Constraint    | A room can be booked only if it does not overlap another active booking.                                                          |
| BR02   | Computation   | Room price equals price_per_night multiplied by actual stayed nights.                                                             |
| BR03   | Workflow      | Service order status must follow ORDERED -> PROCESSING -> COMPLETED/CANCELLED.                                                    |
| BR04   | Computation   | Only COMPLETED service orders are included in checkout invoice.                                                                   |
| BR05   | Automation    | After checkout, room status automatically changes from IN_USE to DIRTY.                                                           |
| BR06   | Authorization | Only receptionist role can confirm check-in and check-out.                                                                        |
| BR07   | Security      | Password must be hashed with BCrypt before storage.                                                                               |
| BR08   | Constraint    | Each booking has only one final payment/invoice settlement.                                                                       |
| BR09   | Constraint    | A pending reservation is valid for 24 hours and may be cancelled automatically if not confirmed.                                  |
| BR10   | Audit         | Critical changes such as check-in, checkout, cancellation, service cancellation, and price update must be recorded in audit_logs. |

## 4\.
